script.title: A SAFE SCHOOL LUNCH
script.scene_zh: 學校餐廳 · 安排免花生午餐
script.story_hook: A mom arranges a safe lunch for her allergic son.
script.intro_zh: 一位媽媽為花生過敏的兒子安排安全的學校午餐。
script.welcome_en: Hi there, lovely to have you! Today we're talking about a peanut-free lunch.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，很高興有你在！今天我們要聊的是無花生的學校午餐。
script.outro: One form, one red tray, big peace of mind. See you next episode.
script.outro_zh: 一份表格、一個紅托盤，換來大大安心。下集再見。
script.practice_intro_en: Time to repeat after me, nice and slow.
script.practice_intro_zh: 輪到跟著我慢慢複誦了。
script.char_a_description: a careful mother in her early thirties with hair pulled into a low bun and small pearl earrings, wearing an olive green field jacket over a plain tee, holding a printed medical form
script.char_b_description: a kind cafeteria worker in her forties with short permed brown hair and a blue hair net, wearing a gray uniform with a vinyl glove box at her side, leaning on the serving counter
script.youtube_title: 【🥜午餐過敏英文】「我們非常重視」怎麼說？🍽️紅托盤制度一次聽懂，家長必學｜🎧A2 聽力練習｜Peanut-Free Lunch
script.youtube_title_en: “We Take It Seriously Here” — Arranging a Peanut-Free Lunch
script.youtube_description:
孩子對花生過敏，開學時要跟餐廳怎麼交代？這段家長與學校餐飲人員的對話，教你遞過敏表、確認標籤托盤與座位政策，一句一句聽懂安全安排。整段 18 句美式日常英語，附上繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽一遍就敢開口用。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Does your child have a peanut allergy? This school cafeteria conversation has every phrase you need. A parent hands in the allergy form, learns how labeled trays and the allergy-safe table work, and leaves with real peace of mind. 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA, plus a listen-and-repeat section.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🥜午餐過敏英文｜過敏表格・標籤托盤・安全座位｜聽完就敢交代｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
孩子花生過敏，開學第一天要跟誰說、怎麼說？
紅托盤、安全座位，聽起來好複雜？

這一集帶大家走進學校午餐餐廳，跟著一位媽媽從遞交過敏表、確認標籤托盤制度，到搞定座位政策與聯絡窗口，全程都用自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
📋 交代過敏：例如「my son has a peanut allergy」、「Do you need a form from our doctor?」。
🔴 托盤與座位：例如「We'll pack his lunch on a red tray」、「he'll sit at the allergy-safe table.」。
🛡️ 安心政策：例如「We take it seriously here, don't worry」、「Just call the cafeteria line」。 

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

開學季要來了，先把這段替孩子聽熟！
script.thumbnail_action: handing an allergy form over the counter

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, my son has a peanut allergy.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ maɪ sʌn hæz ə ˈpinɑːt əˈlɜrdʒi/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, thanks for telling me right away.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ θæŋks fɔr ˈtɛlɪŋ mi raɪt əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 喔，謝謝你第一時間告訴我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you need a form from our doctor?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju nid ə fɔrm frʌm ˈaʊər ˈdɑktər/
dialogue.zh: 你們需要醫生開的過敏表格嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, an allergy form, and we'll set it up.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs əˈlɜrdʒi fɔrm ænd wil sɛt ɪt ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 需要，有了過敏表我們就能安排。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have it printed. Here you go.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ɪt ˈprɪntɪd hɪr ju ɡoʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. I'll file it this afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will they serve peanut foods in the hall?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðeɪ sɜrv ˈpinɑːt fudz ɪn ðə hɔl/
dialogue.zh: 餐廳裡會端出花生類的餐點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, we label trays that may contain it.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl wi ˈleɪbəl treɪz ðæt meɪ kənˈteɪn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，可能含花生的托盤都會貼標籤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, how will I know his tray is safe?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm haʊ wɪl aɪ noʊ hɪz treɪ ɪz seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 呃，那我要怎麼知道他的托盤是安全的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll pack his lunch on a red tray.
dialogue.phonetic: /wil pæk hɪz lʌntʃ ɑn ə rɛd treɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我們會用紅色托盤裝他的午餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And he'll sit at the allergy-safe table.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd hil sɪt æt ði əˈlɜrdʒi seɪf ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 而且他會坐在過敏安全的那一桌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does that mean kids nearby eat carefully too?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðæt min kɪdz ˈnɪrbi it ˈkɛrfəli tu/
dialogue.zh: 這代表旁邊的孩子也會特別注意吃什麼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, everyone at that table is checked.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ˈɛvriwʌn æt ðæt ˈteɪbəl ɪz tʃɛkt/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，那一桌每個人的餐點都會檢查。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That makes me feel much better, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt meks mi fil mʌtʰ ˈbɛtər ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，我真的安心多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We take it seriously here, don't worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi teɪk ɪt ˈsɪriəsli hɪr doʊnt ˈwʌri/
dialogue.zh: 我們在這裡非常重視這件事，別擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you! Who do I call with questions?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju hu du aɪ kɔl wɪð ˈkwɛstʃənz/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝！有問題我該打給誰？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just call the cafeteria line, any school day.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst kɔl ðə kæfəˈtɛrɪə laɪn ˈɛni skul deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 上學日期間，直接打餐廳專線就好。
